besluite.fout: 'om die plant' after 'met die lug' can be read at first as an infinitive 'om ... te' clause, so the reader stumbles
besluite.rede: 'rondom die plant' is the natural, unambiguous way to say the surrounding air, and the meaning is unchanged.
'Daarby' already reads naturally here as 'in the process / in addition', and 'Daarmee saam' is a lateral move that is no clearer.

besluite.fout: 'in en uit jou lyf' with a verb of motion copies English 'in and out of your body'; Afrikaans marks direction with the postposed particles
besluite.rede: 'jou lyf in en uit' is the idiomatic Afrikaans directional form and says exactly the same thing.
'weer' naturally carries both 'in turn' and 'back out' here, the bok has not exhaled before so 'again' is not a real reading, and 'op sy beurt' is longer and narrows it.
Dropping 'wel' loses the concessive contrast with the previous sentence, and the original word order with the 'soos jy' phrase after the particles is acceptable Afrikaans.
